coulomb.name: Coulomb's Law
coulomb.desc: Force between two point charges. k = 9×10^9 N·m²/C²
coulomb.subject: Physics

gauss.name: Gauss's Law
gauss.desc: Total flux through closed surface = enclosed charge / ε₀
gauss.subject: Physics

capacitance.name: Parallel Plate Capacitor
capacitance.desc: With dielectric: C = K ε₀ A / d
capacitance.subject: Physics

dipole_field.name: Dipole Field (axial)
dipole_field.desc: Field on axis of dipole at distance r >> dipole length
dipole_field.subject: Physics

kirchhoff_v.name: Kirchhoff's Voltage Law
kirchhoff_v.desc: Algebraic sum of voltages around any closed loop = 0
kirchhoff_v.subject: Physics

biot_savart.name: Biot-Savart Law
biot_savart.desc: Magnetic field due to current element
biot_savart.subject: Physics

ampere.name: Ampere's Law
ampere.desc: Line integral of B around closed loop
ampere.subject: Physics

faraday.name: Faraday's Law
faraday.desc: Induced EMF = rate of change of magnetic flux
faraday.subject: Physics

snells.name: Snell's Law
snells.formula: μ₁ sin i = μ₂ sin r
snells.subject: Physics

young.name: Young's Double Slit
young.desc: Fringe width. Path diff = d sin θ ≈ d y/D
young.subject: Physics

mole.name: Mole Concept
mole.desc: Number of moles from mass or gas volume
mole.subject: Chemistry

kp_kc.name: Kp-Kc Relation
kp_kc.desc: Δn = moles gaseous products - moles gaseous reactants
kp_kc.subject: Chemistry

nernst.name: Nernst Equation
nernst.desc: Cell potential under non-standard conditions. At 298K: E = E° - (0.0591/n) log Q
nernst.subject: Chemistry

binom.name: Binomial Theorem
binom.desc: General term: T_{r+1} = C(n,r) x^(n-r) y^r
binom.subject: Mathematics

perm.name: Permutations
perm.desc: Arrangements of r from n distinct
perm.subject: Mathematics

comb.name: Combinations
comb.desc: Selections of r from n distinct
comb.subject: Mathematics

derivative_basic.name: Basic Derivatives
derivative_basic.formula: d/dx(x^n)=nx^(n-1), d/dx(sin x)=cos x, d/dx(e^x)=e^x, d/dx(ln x)=1/x
derivative_basic.subject: Mathematics

integration_basic.name: Basic Integrals
integration_basic.formula: ∫ x^n dx = x^(n+1)/(n+1), ∫ e^x dx = e^x, ∫ 1/x dx = ln|x|, ∫ sin x dx = -cos x, ∫ cos x dx = sin x
integration_basic.subject: Mathematics

by_parts.name: Integration by Parts
by_parts.desc: LIATE rule for choosing u: Log, Inverse trig, Algebraic, Trig, Exponential
by_parts.subject: Mathematics

definite_props.name: Definite Integral Properties
definite_props.desc: King property: ∫_0^a f(x)dx = ∫_0^a f(a-x)dx. Queen: ∫_0^{π/2} f(sin x, cos x)dx = ∫_0^{π/2} f(cos x, sin x)dx
definite_props.subject: Mathematics

line_eq.name: Line Equation (3D)
line_eq.desc: Symmetric form. Vector: r = r₁ + λ(a,b,c)
line_eq.subject: Mathematics

flux_sign.desc: Flux = E·A·cosθ. Inward flux negative, outward positive. Gaussian surface orientation matters.
flux_sign.example: Charge inside cube: flux through each face = q/(6ε₀) OUTWARD. If asked 'flux entering', answer is negative.

dipole_moment_dir.desc: p points from -q to +q (opposite to field direction inside dipole). Many forget this.
dipole_moment_dir.example: Torque τ = p × E. p direction matters for cross product.

capacitor_series_parallel.desc: Series: 1/Ceq = Σ 1/Ci (charge same). Parallel: Ceq = Σ Ci (voltage same). Dielectric insertion geometry critical.
capacitor_series_parallel.example: Dielectric fills half thickness → SERIES. Half area → PARALLEL.

limiting_reagent_excess.desc: Don't just find limiting reagent. Calculate excess remaining: n_excess = n_initial - (coeff_excess/coeff_limiting) × n_limiting_used
limiting_reagent_excess.example: 2H₂ + O₂ → 2H₂O. If 4 mol H₂, 3 mol O₂: H₂ limiting. O₂ used = 2 mol. Excess O₂ = 1 mol.

kinetics_order_molecularity.desc: Molecularity = elementary step (integer). Order = experimental (can be fractional, zero). Only equal for elementary reactions.
kinetics_order_molecularity.example: H₂ + Br₂ → 2HBr. Rate = k[H₂][Br₂]^(1/2). Order = 1.5, Molecularity = 2.

nernst_temperature.desc: E = E° - (0.0591/n) log Q at 298K. Don't use 0.0591 at other temperatures!
nernst_temperature.example: At 310K: factor = (RT/F) ln 10 = 0.0615. Use (0.0615/n) log Q.

integration_constant.desc: Indefinite: +C always. Definite: NO +C. Limits absorb it.

pnc_identical_distinct.desc: Distinct objects into distinct boxes: n^r. Identical objects into distinct boxes: C(n+r-1, r).
pnc_identical_distinct.example: 5 identical balls into 3 distinct boxes: C(5+3-1, 5) = C(7,5) = 21.

vector_cross_order.desc: a × b = - (b × a). Direction by right-hand rule. Torque τ = r × F, not F × r.

gauss_symmetry.desc: Point charge at center of cube/sphere/cylinder. Flux per face = Q/(n ε₀). n = number of symmetric faces.

dipole_uniform_field.desc: Torque = pE sinθ. PE = -pE cosθ. Stable eq at θ=0. Oscillation period T = 2π√(I/pE).

capacitor_dielectric_battery.desc: Battery connected: V constant, Q changes. Battery disconnected: Q constant, V changes. Energy: U = ½CV² = Q²/2C.

kirchhoff_wheatstone.desc: Balanced: P/Q = R/S → no current through galvanometer. Unbalanced: use Kirchhoff's laws or symmetry.

organic_mechanism_steps.desc: Identify: electrophile, nucleophile, leaving group. Draw ALL arrows. Carbocation stability: 3° > 2° > 1° > methyl. Rearrangements: hydride/alkyl shift to more stable carbocation.

integration_king_property.desc: ∫_0^a f(x)dx = ∫_0^a f(a-x)dx. Use when f(x)+f(a-x) simplifies. Queen: ∫_0^{π/2} f(sin x, cos x)dx = ∫_0^{π/2} f(cos x, sin x)dx.

complex_numbers_rotation.desc: Multiply by e^(iθ) = rotation by θ. |z| = 1 → on unit circle. Cube roots of unity: 1, ω, ω² where 1+ω+ω²=0, ω³=1.

probability_bayes.desc: P(A|B) = P(B|A)P(A)/P(B). Total probability: P(B) = Σ P(B|Aᵢ)P(Aᵢ). Common: defective items from machines, medical tests.
